doc.title: Javon Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Legislation and police reflecting their communities
summary: Both hope for real change; Jackson calls for legislation and police who live in the communities they serve.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: I hope that, I think Biden said this is a wake up call. You’d think there’s been lot of wake up calls before, I’m hoping that this indeed will be one.

Right. Legislation. There needs to be some legislation. Let’s legislate about it. And from there we’ll start to see. And I think what’s important, someone mentioned this, to have more of the police in a sense reflect the communities that they’re from and let them work in the communities by which they live so people can have a chance to have relationships with their policemen.
